claim: A build that adds several things at once cannot say which worked. In Gravesend's shopfronts (2026-11-18) we made variants of the built map with one feature removed each, rendered from the same poses as five unlabelled sets for one blind reviewer: it named the three features that varied and the pairs that differ in one, and rated the sign decisive, the surround helpful, and the unlit displays (which it read as dark glass) mildly harmful.
evidence: projects/blood-city/experiments/shop-surrounds/README.md (2026-11-18) and critic.md:26-40: 'Three things vary, each switched on or off independently'; 'Sign: decisive', 'Surround: helps', 'Dark glass: hurts, mildly'
use: Plan ablations and predict their order before building; take the 'without' values from the before map.
